newsitem.title: CANADA: Minorca adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Minorca adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Minorca Resources Inc said on Tuesday that it adopted a shareholder rights plan.
Minorca said the plan was not meant to prevent takeovers but was an attempt to make sure all shareholders were treated fairly and not subjected to abusive takeover strategies.
The board authorized the issue of one right for each common share of the company to holders of record at the close of business on February 26, 1997, Minorca said.

If a bidder acquired 20 percent or more of the common shares in an offer not permitted by the board, the rights would become exercisable, entitling the holder to buy common shares at a 50 percent discount to the market price.
The plan took effect today, but required confirmation by shareholders by the annual meeting on May 22, Minorca said.
